---
# To add a person: copy this folder to people/<lastname>_<firstname>/,
# rename this file to index.qmd and replace Missing_avatar.jpg with a
# square photo named avatar.jpg.
title: "First Last"            # name as displayed on the site
last: "Last"                   # used to sort the People page alphabetically
first: "First"
people_group: phd              # one of: pi, professional, postdoc, phd, masters, honours, alumni
                               # (only "alumni" changes where the card appears)
email: "first.last@uq.edu.au"
subtitle: "PhD Student"        # role shown on the card, e.g. "Honours Student", "Lab Manager"
description: ""
image: avatar.jpg
listing:
  id: pubs
  template: ../../_ejs/publications-people.ejs
  contents:
    - "../../../publications/**/*.qmd"
    - "!../../../publications/_template/"
  sort: "pub_number desc"
  filter-ui: true
  include:
    author: "First Last"       # name exactly as it appears on papers
  fields: [publication, title, categories, image, date, author]
page-layout: full
about:
  id: about
  template: trestles
  image-shape: round
  image: avatar.jpg
  links:                       # remove this block if there's no email address
    - icon: envelope
      text: Email
      href: mailto:first.last@uq.edu.au
---

:::{#about}

A short bio, written in the first or third person.

:::
